definitions.explanation: Something that prevents normal functioning or progress. Often used in the pattern ～に{支障|ししょう}がある/をきたす (to cause problems for).

examples.japanese: ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{支障|ししょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no hindrance to operations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{支障|ししょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧きたす{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a risk of it causing health problems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{支障|ししょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じたら→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you feel pain severe enough to interfere with daily life, please go to the hospital.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word commonly seen in business, medical, and administrative contexts. Very often appears in the negative pattern {支障|ししょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧/⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (there is no problem, no hindrance). The phrase {支障|ししょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧きたす (to bring about an impediment) is a set expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {支障|ししょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a hindrance, to be a problem
- {支障|ししょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no problem, no hindrance
- {支障|ししょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧きたす: to cause a problem, to impede
- {支障|ししょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to develop problems
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{支障|ししょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no problem with...

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧ (master, teacher), which shares the same reading.
